'''Giviots''' were a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]. [[Flanth-house]]s such as the [[Grass Hutt]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] served giviots alongside [[flanth steak]]s and sauteed [[balka greens]].<ref name="CB">{{JournalCite|14|Crimson Bounty}}</ref>
